drop_reasons.PFE: Spread 500.6bp (far too wide). ATR $0.57 on a $24 stock produces cramped stop/target structure. No catalyst. Skipped.

regime_drivers: Asian chip meltdown (Samsung/SK Hynix -10%, Kospi suspended)
Friday risk reduction after Micron-driven rally week
_meta.note: Strategist regime: RISK-OFF. INTC = PASS (chip selloff, no short). NVDA downgraded to VWAP reclaim only, half size ($5k). AMZN ORB with higher bar. ORB levels fill in live after the open (orb_high/orb_low remain null until ~9:45 AM ET). Key event: UMich Sentiment 10:00 AM ET — be small or flat into the print.

NVDA.reason: Highest-volume name on the list (3.72M sh/day). ATR of $6.64 gives the best reward structure. Relatively resilient vs peers in chip selloff (-0.6% vs INTC -3%+).
NVDA.note: RISK-OFF regime: no ORB breakout long in a chip-selloff tape. Setup downgraded to VWAP reclaim only. Max size $5,000 (half the normal $10k cap). Entry only if NVDA pulls back, holds $190, and reclaims VWAP on volume. If $190 breaks on volume, stand aside. Do not enter before 9:45 AM ET. Asian chip meltdown (Samsung/SK Hynix -10%) is the headwind.

AMZN.reason: Second-tightest spread on the list (5.3bp premarket) and a large ATR of $7.68. The flat -0.1% gap means no gap-fill overhang. Clean large-cap with a workable range. $225 is the nearest round-number support and $230 is a round resistance target.
AMZN.note: Gap essentially flat — fresh ORB candidate. Support at $225 (round); resistance at $230 (round, about 1 ATR above PM). ORB breakout above range high on volume is the entry signal. RISK-OFF adjustment: higher bar than normal — skip if no clean ORB by 10:15 AM ET. No re-entry on continuation thesis (June 24 loss was exactly that). 90-minute ORB rule strictly enforced. Prime Day ends today — mild positive backdrop but no breakout catalyst. Lower priority than NVDA.

INTC.reason: Down 3%+ premarket in chip selloff (Samsung/SK Hynix -10% overnight). Stretched valuation (30% above analyst target). No positive catalyst until July 23 earnings.
INTC.note: PASS for the day. Cannot short. Buying into this chip-selloff tape has no edge. Yesterday's catalyst (Micron/Goldman/BofA) is fully priced in. Do not trade INTC today under any circumstances.

NFLX.reason: Tightest premarket spread on the entire list (25bp) and strong average volume (3.33M sh/day). Kept because the spread is genuinely good and the ATR of $2.20 allows workable stop structure.
NFLX.note: NFLX is near 52-week lows, no positive catalyst today, and has no sector alignment with the AI/chip theme. The +0.4% gap is noise. Kept on the list only because the spread is excellent. If it produces a clean VWAP reclaim from $71 with above-average volume, consider a small trade. Otherwise, watch-only. Do not trade NFLX if there are live positions in NVDA or AMZN competing for attention.

BAC.reason: Extremely tight spread (5.2bp) and decent volume (2.29M sh/day). Easy to get in and out. Kept as the lowest-risk fallback if the primary names produce no setups.
BAC.note: ATR of $1.11 is small, limiting the reward per trade. No BAC-specific catalyst; moves with the broad market. Support at $57.50 (round below), resistance at $58.50 (above prev close $58.38 — a natural ceiling). Only trade BAC if it reclaims VWAP with volume in the first hour and the broader market is trending. If BAC is flat by 10:30 AM, skip for the day. Lowest priority on the list.
